test_title: PYST 71: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following initiatives was launched by the Union Ministry of Tribal Affairs in 2025 to improve the implementation of tribal welfare schemes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adi Karmyogi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Union Ministry of Tribal Affairs** launched the **Adi Karmyogi** initiative in **2025** to enhance the administrative efficiency and service delivery of tribal welfare schemes across India.
 
• The primary objective of **Adi Karmyogi** is the **capacity building** and sensitization of officials and personnel working at various levels of the tribal developmental administration, including those in **Integrated Tribal Development Agencies (ITDAs)**.
 
• The program is designed to provide specialized training to government employees to better understand the **unique cultural, social, and geographical challenges** faced by tribal communities.
 
• By fostering a "citizen-centric" approach, the initiative aims to bridge the gap between policy formulation and ground-level implementation of schemes like **PM-JANMAN** and **Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS)**.
 
• It focuses on leveraging digital tools and **e-learning modules** to ensure that the personnel remain updated with the latest guidelines and statutory provisions related to **Scheduled Tribes (ST)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mission Karmayogi (NPCSCB):**
 
 
• **Adi Karmyogi** is an extension of the **National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB)**, popularly known as **Mission Karmayogi**, which was launched in **September 2020**.
 
• The broader mission aims to transform Indian civil services from "Rule-based" to **"Role-based"** governance, ensuring civil servants are creative, proactive, and technology-enabled.
 
 
 
• **Tribal Population in India:**
 
 
• According to the **2011 Census**, the tribal population constitutes approximately **8.6%** of India's total population.
 
• There are over **700** recognized Scheduled Tribes, with states like **Madhya Pradesh**, **Odisha**, and **Maharashtra** having significant tribal concentrations.
 
• **Part IX-A** and **Schedules V and VI** of the **Constitution of India** provide specific administrative frameworks for tribal-dominated areas.
 
 
 
• **Other Significant Tribal Schemes:**
 
 
• **PM-JANMAN:** Launched to focus on **Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs)**, covering **75** such groups across **18** States and **1** Union Territory.
 
• **Van Dhan Vikas Kendras:** An initiative targeting **livelihood generation** for tribal gatherers through value addition of **Minor Forest Produce (MFP)**.
 
• **Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS):** Started in **1997-98** to provide quality middle and high-level education to ST students in remote areas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Training and Sensitization:** The **Adi Karmyogi** initiative emphasizes understanding **Tribal Rights**, the **Forest Rights Act (2006)**, and the **PESA Act (1996)** to protect tribal interests during administrative processes.
 
• **Data-Driven Governance:** The initiative encourages the use of the **Gati Shakti** portal and other **GIS-based** mapping tools to identify infrastructure gaps in tribal hamlets.
 
• **Implementing Agency:** The **National Institute of Tribal Research (NITR)** often plays a pivotal role in designing the curriculum for such capacity-building programs in collaboration with the **Capacity Building Commission (CBC)**.
 
• **Focus on PVTGs:** A core component of the **2025** rollout is to ensure that welfare reaches the most **marginalized sections** within the tribal community who have historically been excluded from mainstream developmental benefits.
